# Pull request

## Change

Describe the concrete problem, the resulting behavior, and the approved requirement.

## Verification

Link the check results and describe relevant test evidence or limitations.

## Checklist

- [ ] Completed all planned commits before opening this PR.
- [ ] Authored every development commit on a feature branch and made no direct development commits or pushes to `main`, `master`, or `mainline`.
- [ ] Kept excluded local documents out of tracked files, proposed commit history, and shared-document links.
- [ ] Followed one test case per TDD commit and recorded red/green or already-passing evidence.
- [ ] Passed formatting, lint, type, build, and all current tests for every proposed commit.
- [ ] Met at least 93% line, statement, branch, and function coverage.
- [ ] Passed the complete configured mutation gate without weakening thresholds.
- [ ] Passed dependency, license, and secret checks.
- [ ] Preserved source provenance, case isolation, and neutral presentation where applicable.
- [ ] Verified applicable desktop/mobile behavior and accessibility.
- [ ] Updated relevant documentation and local development records.
- [ ] Used one-sentence commit subjects beginning with a past-tense verb.
- [ ] Received another team member's review, or recorded the project owner's explicit review-only override below.
- [ ] Left final merge approval and execution to the project owner.

## Review override

Leave this section empty when another team member approved the PR. If the project owner overrides the review requirement, record the owner's decision, reason, and date. The override does not waive quality gates or authorize a direct push to a protected branch.
